children: Overview
UAE offshore vessel operator's H1 2026 adjusted revenue declined 3% yr/yr due to Gulf conflict
Gross profit dropped sharply, mainly from impairment losses and operational disruptions
Company incurred net loss for H1 2026, compared to net profit in prior year
Outlook
GMS targets FY2026 adjusted EBITDA of US$ 105-115 mln, assuming no renewed Gulf conflict
Company expects H2 2026 earnings recovery from Latin America expansion and vessel redeployment in Europe
GMS continues to defer shareholder distribution policy due to Gulf geopolitical risks
Result Drivers
GULF CONFLICT - Co said revenue and profit were hit by vessel evacuations and operational disruptions caused by the conflict in the Gulf
IMPAIRMENT LOSS - Co recognised US$ 22.7 mln impairment on property and equipment, mainly due to ongoing geopolitical situation in Gulf region
LOWER FLEET UTILISATION - Average fleet utilisation fell to 75% from 87%, affected by Gulf conflict and planned vessel preparation in Europe
